measurementPolicy.gainMethod: Original minus candidate median dBFS of 20ms higher-energy ASR-word-anchored frames; record all distributions and per-word pairs first.
measurementPolicy.boundaryMethod: Inspect complete ASR gap with30ms margins. Quiet plateaus are hypotheses only; low energy and ASR do not certify non-speech or breath continuity. Output traces and candidate sample intervals for root acoustic decision, never select a verified cut.
